about.subtitle: About Me
about.title: Navigating the Journey Together
about.bio1: Hi, I am Aradhana Baghare, a Counselling Psychologist based in Madhya Pradesh, India. I hold an M.A. in Counselling Psychology and specialize in a CBT-informed, integrative therapeutic approach.
about.bio2: My practice focuses on providing a safe, empathetic environment where clients can explore their emotions, regulate their experiences, and foster meaningful personal wellness. I specialize in helping individuals navigate anxiety, stress, trauma, relationship challenges, and low self-esteem. I integrate Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT) alongside expressive arts, play-based, and movement-oriented interventions.
